description: Resolve a place name, borough, Tube or rail station, outward code or full postcode to the London postcode district(s) the other tools take. Returns up to 15 matches with their borough(s) and how each matched. To screen districts on prices, commute, crime, schools, flood or rent, use find_london_districts instead.

query.description: A place ("Walthamstow", "Clapham"), borough ("Hackney"), station ("Clapham Junction"), outward code ("SW1") or postcode ("E17 4QH").

name: find_london_district
title: Find a London postcode district
